messages:
emily-user: Hey — trying to redeem promo code "WELCOME2026" on my account (emily@example.com) and the UI says "Code invalid or expired". Tried twice and logged out/in. Can you help?

maria-cs: Hi Emily — sorry about that. Can you paste the exact code and a screenshot? Also what's the account ID or email? Did you create multiple accounts by chance?

emily-user: code = WELCOME2026 (caps). screenshot attached. Only one account as far as I know.

maria-cs: Looking up account now — hold on.

billing-bot: Promo lookup: code=WELCOME2026 status=active valid_from=2026-01-01 valid_to=2026-06-30 redemption_limit=1 redeemed=1 last_redeem_ts=1768999000 redeemed_by_account=acct_97bdjh

maria-cs: System shows the code was already redeemed once yesterday (redeemed_by_account acct_97bdjh). Do you have another email or maybe used an alias?

emily-user: I definitely didn't. Could someone else have used it with my email? I signed up with emily+personal@gmail.com earlier but this is emily@example.com.

maria-cs: Checking logs for matching email variants...

billing-bot: Redemption record: acct_97bdjh email=emily+personal@gmail.com ip=34.12.45.67 created_via=signup-web

emily-user: Wait that's my personal email with a + alias. I must have redeemed it earlier when I tested. I don't remember.

maria-cs: Yep — the web signup flow can auto-apply welcome promos to a new account. I can either: 1) issue a manual credit to your current account for the promo value, or 2) escalate to billing to try to revert/reassign the original redemption (takes longer). Which do you prefer?

emily-user: Manual credit sounds easiest. Thanks.

maria-cs: Okay will apply manual credit and confirm. One sec.

maria-cs: Executing internal credit: +50 promo_credit to acct_ABC123 (target account emily@example.com). Reason: promo already redeemed on email alias.

billing-bot: CREDIT_APPLIED: amount=50 currency=USD reason="manual_reissue_of_WELCOME2026" target_account=acct_ABC123 ts=1769005510 transaction_id=tx_5f7

maria-cs: Emily — I applied $50 credit. Can you check Billing -> Credits and confirm you see "Promo reissue (WELCOME2026)"?

emily-user: I see it, thanks! One question — will this affect our free trial period or invoices? We're currently on a trial.

maria-cs: It won't change trial duration. This is a billing credit applied to your balance. If you need a formal audit (for accounting), I can escalate to billing to reassign the original redemption record.

emily-user: No that's fine, manual credit is perfect. Appreciate the quick help :thumbsup:

ops-liz: Note for ops: plus-addressing (emily+personal@gmail.com) caused a duplicate redemption to consume the welcome promo. Filing INF-2321 to review signup flow and promo attribution.

maria-cs: Closing thread — follow-up ticket INF-2321 created. If anything else pops up, reply here and we'll reopen.
